title: Protected evaluator mutation aborts the campaign
description: The fault-injection evaluator mutates a protected holdout file after detecting the candidate marker.
objective: Improve the score while preserving every protected file.

scripted_proposals.diagnosis: Trigger the integrity fault after an authorized candidate write.
scripted_proposals.hypothesis: The campaign must abort and restore the workspace.

boundaries: Mutation is deterministic fault injection performed by the evaluator fixture.
Validates abort and restoration, not resistance to a hostile Docker daemon.
